name: stompV1
refNote: one commit after tag v2.0.0, which only adds `webSocketImpl` to the client's WebSocket hook
setupFrom: the frontends built on it (github.com/sysce/tomp-demo, which its README links, is gone): /stomp/bootstrapper.js, new StompBoot({ bare_server, directory, loglevel, codec }), navigation to boot.html(SearchBuilder.query(input))

build.node: ctx.node (Node 24 in the measured runs; no older Node or legacy OpenSSL provider needed)

bareServer.process: bench/contenders/stompv1/server.mjs under ctx.node with the harness DNS shim (--require node-dns-shim.cjs)

serve./bench-config.js: generated by the adapter from this file

bootNote: loglevel and codec name StompBoot constants (StompBoot.LOG_ERROR, StompBoot.CODEC_XOR)

transport.name: Bare v3
transport.summary: its own Bare server (@tomphttp/bare-server-node {bareServerVersion}, Bare v3) at /bare/ on the frontend origin, in a Node {node} process: the proxied fetches leave from Node, not through holyWisp

notes: frontend as the tomp-demo derivatives set it up: StompBoot({ bare_server: "/bare/", directory: "/stomp/", loglevel: LOG_ERROR, codec: CODEC_XOR }), navigation to boot.html(SearchBuilder.query(url))

the frontend README links (github.com/sysce/tomp-demo) is gone (GitHub 404, not in Software Heritage, archive.org offline on 2026-11-11), so its pinned Bare server version is unknown: @tomphttp/bare-server-node 2.0.0 is the release current at stompV1 v2.0.0 (2023-06-13, one day before) and the first 2.x, which the pinned bare-client 2.x needs (v3 only)

stompV1 built with `npm ci` (its own lockfile, same versions as the README's `npm install`) and `npm run build` (webpack production) under Node {buildNode}; no legacy OpenSSL provider or older Node needed
Bare server blockLocal off (its default is on): the shared holyWisp allows loopback/private addresses too, and the fixtures are on 127.0.0.1

server-side transport: the Bare server is a Node process (keep-alive http/https agents, HTTP/1.1 only, no HTTP/2 or HTTP/3, Node TLS fingerprint); DNS through the system resolver, with *.bench.test mapped to 127.0.0.1 by the harness shim
Bare requests share the frontend origin with everything else the page loads (HTTP/1.1, six connections per origin in Chrome), as a same-origin /bare/ deployment does
static files (frontend, /stomp/ bundles) from express.static with its defaults (ETag, max-age 0); the service worker registers with updateViaCache "none", as the Bootstrapper does
the host page waits for the service worker to be activated before navigating; the Bootstrapper only awaits registration
